pages.text: $(thing)Moonblossom$() is a glowing flower (night vision in suspicious stew). $(thing)Glow Fern$(), $(thing)Glow Algae$() and $(thing)Lumen Reeds$() carpet the land and swamps. $(thing)Lumen Fruit$() gives brief night vision; $(thing)Lumen Nectar$() (bottle a Stillbloom) gives regeneration.
Right-click soil with a Glowberry to plant a bush. Bone-meal it to ripen; right-click a ripe bush to harvest — it regrows.
Glowcap Stew — hearty, with night vision. Returns the bowl.
